reviewSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. D-353 records leftover-join.v32 of G21 as the G21 leftover remasurement after D-352, and every load-bearing claim survives measurement against live bytes. All 13 cited digests and the one cited commit recompute exactly at the paths the entry names. Independently of Stage A, all 163 recordedInputs digests of the frozen successor also recompute exactly and its head equals live HEAD, so the entry is not recording a stale candidate. The Stage A disposition table is exact member for member on both sides: Claude ACCEPT with a top-level verdict, no decision field, five unlabeled observation strings and counts 0/0/0/0/5; Codex ACCEPT with a top-level verdict, no decision field, finalDecision as the string ACCEPT, and every list empty. The observation discipline holds in all three directions at once — the v31 Claude observations are correctly recited as five labeled objects with members id and note and OBS-1 through OBS-5 are named, the v32 Claude observations are correctly called unlabeled strings with no id member, and the v30 Claude ACCEPT observations are likewise unlabeled; no observation identifier is invented and every Codex finding is recited as unlabeled with no id member. The two frozen predecessor MUST-FIX classes were traced into the successor's own bytes: G21LJ-V31-M1's restoration of the v29 Findings-land destination to leftover-join.v30 of G21, and the v30 Codex last-heading class, both present, so the recited landings are true of bytes rather than asserted. The obligations this entry must not touch stay untouched — leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING remains open and leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is [], leftover-join.v14 of sarif and g21-fixture-corpus.v26 and v25 keep their prior recordings, occupancy v4 is unmoved, and v28 is guarded only in the qualified 'after this successor is recorded' form that its live standing requires. No lineage collapses: the different-lineages disclaimer is present and no corpus v32 is named or exists. Custody holds — HEAD unmoved across the review, last live heading D-352, COORD and file 08 at their dispatched digests with zero modified tracked files, required-now 28, DR-G21 OPEN and still PROPOSED-not-QUALIFIED, DR-107 and DR-118 unflattened, DR-102 not reopened, D-272 correctly excluded from the no-cell-edit branch, and docs/v2/implementation absent from disk. All 14 dispatched attacks were run plus 8 added attacks of my own; none of the 22 landed. Five observations are recorded as honesty work — an omitted v25 line, one loose plural, a field-name shorthand, two vestigial D-319 guards, and the successor's convention-following reviewStatus token — and none of them is a bar to recording.
